faq.text: 🍿 | Hi, our bot is pretty big, and there's a lot of info. Here's a few categories, pick the info you want to get >
faq.game_point:
🦕 In DinoGochi you become the owner of a unique dinosaur. Our game combines the atmosphere of a classic tamagotchi with elements of a role-playing game (RPG): you take care of your pet, develop its skills, participate in adventures and competitions.

🎋 However DinoGochi - it's not only care. Your path is yours:
- You can focus on developing your dinosaur, training it and unlocking new abilities.
- Or engage in trading rare resources, building your own economy.
- Or you may want to explore the world, participate in events, join with other players or compete for the title of the strongest.

✨ DinoGochi - is an open sandbox where you choose your own style of play.
 Grow, trade, explore, conquer - or simply enjoy life with your dinosaur.
faq.dino_mood:
🎈 *What is your dinosaur's mood?*
Mood reflects your dinosaur's overall state: how happy, satisfied, and ready for new adventures it is. Monitoring mood is important for faster development and better performance during travels.

🍎 *What affects mood?*
Mood depends on your attention: play with your dinosaur, care for it, feed it favorite dishes, and don't forget to interact. The more care - the better the mood!

👀 *Where to check mood?*
You can see the current mood in your dinosaur's profile. We display it through special indicators and color marks.

💥 *What gives good or bad mood?*
Good mood provides useful bonuses: faster development, more successful battles, and easier task completion. Bad mood may cause nervous breakdowns: the dinosaur might refuse commands or lose motivation.
faq.dino_height:
*🌱 What about the dinosaurs' growth?*
A dinosaur grows for 30 days after birth. However, each dinosaur is unique: some may grow into large creatures, while others will remain small.
faq.kindergarten:
🏫 *What is the Kindergarten?*
Kindergarten is a premium feature that allows you to send your dinosaur to daycare for several hours a day. During this time, the pet is taken care of and it maintains a good mood.
faq.dino_skills:
🎯 *What are dinosaur skills?*
Skills are characteristics that directly affect your dinosaur's success in different activities. They are trained through exercises and unlock various bonuses.

🌟 *What bonuses do skills give?*
- High charm has a chance to cancel bad mood.
- Dexterity reduces task completion time.
- Charm gives a discount on progression.
- High charm increases the chance of getting additional experience when collecting food, playing games, traveling, and snow.
- When collecting resources, there's a higher chance of finding rarer items.
- In dinosaur games, there's an additional bonus with high charm.
- With high intelligence, there's a chance to immediately create 1 more item.

💪 *How to train skills?*
Skills can be trained by sending your dinosaur on training sessions. Different training develops different skills!
faq.settings:
⚙️ *What can be set in the game?*
In DinoGochi there are many settings to make the game more convenient:

- Disable daily notifications about rewards.
- Set inventory page size.
- Rename the dinosaur.
- Adjust profile interface view.
- Delete account.
- Set how dinosaurs will call the owner.
- Choose bot language.
- Enable conversation permission with the owner.
- Set nickname in the bot.
- Reset avatar.

All settings are available in a special menu section.
faq.friends:
🤝 *What are friends in DinoGochi?*
Friends allow interaction with other players and develop co-operative gameplay. Friend possibilities:

- View a friend's profile.
- Share coins and items.
- Breed joint dinosaurs.
- Change a friend's name for convenience.
- Send dinosaurs together to play.

👥 *How to become friends?*
Add a friend through the special menu or via the `/add_me` command in the group.
faq.market:
🏪 *What is the market?*
The market is a completely independent system for exchanging items and coins. Each player can set up their own store profile.

🖼️ *Can I set a profile picture on the market?*
Yes, with a subscription, you can set your profile picture.

💸 *What exchanges are available on the market?*
The market offers the following exchanges:
- Exchange items for coins and vice versa.
- Exchange items for items.
- Auction items, where the highest bid wins.
faq.dino_tavern:
🍻 *What is a tavern?*
A tavern is a place where you can get quests and hear exciting stories.

🎯 *What can you do in the tavern?*
- Get a quest that will give you additional tasks and bonuses.
- Hear interesting stories that may give hints for future adventures.
faq.events:
🎉 *What are events?*
Events are special events in the game that can appear either in the bot or as additional events.

🎮 *What kinds of events are there?*
- Bot events are temporary tasks and activities that appear for a certain time.
- Additional events may include bonuses, new mechanics, or unique items that are available for a limited period.
faq.super_coins:
💎 *What are super coins?*
Super coins - are a special currency that can be obtained by watching ads or through donations.

🎁 *What can be bought with super coins?*
Super coins can be spent on special items available via the command `/super`
faq.more_dinos:
🐾 *How to get more dinosaurs?*
The number of dinosaurs you can keep depends on your level and subscription:

- Every 20th level gives +1 slot for a dinosaur.
- With a premium subscription you get +1 slot.
- There is also always 1 slot available for a shared dinosaur.
faq.craft:
⚒️ *What is crafting?*
Crafting - is the process of creating items using recipes and materials. Some recipes require time to make.

📝 *Where to find recipes?*
Recipes can be found on the market, from a shopkeeper or during a journey.
faq.breakdown:
😣 *What is a nervous breakdown in a dinosaur?*
A nervous breakdown is a state that may occur if the dinosaur's mood is too bad.

⚠️ *How to prevent a nervous breakdown?*
To prevent a nervous breakdown, you need to improve the dinosaur's mood by giving it attention, feeding it, or performing other actions. If this doesn't work right away, just wait, and the mood will improve over time.
faq.general:
🎈 *Rarities*
Events and dinosaurs are divided into rarities.
The higher the rarity, the sweeter the reward.

 1. Common - 50%
 2. Uncommon - 25%
 3. Rare - 15%
 4. Mystic - 9%
 5. Legendary - 1%

🕹 *Interactions*
To interact with the dinosaur, go to `🕹 Actions`.

 1. To feed the dinosaur, you need to obtain food, click on `🕹 Actions` > `🍕 Food Collection` and follow the instructions.

 2. To feed the dinosaur, click on `🕹 Actions` > `🍣 Feed` and choose suitable food.

 3. In `🎮 Entertainment` you can choose a game and entertain the dinosaur to boost its mood.

 4. In `🎑 Journey` you can find various items, meet friends, and see many interesting things!

 5. `🌙 Put to Sleep` the dinosaur needs sleep daily, don't forget to put it to sleep!

🎮 *Profile*
 To view inventory or check your statistics, go to `👁‍🗨 Profile`
faq.eat:
🥙 *What does my dinosaur eat?*
Check your dinosaur's profile - dinosaurs live in their native environment.

Herbivores are where there's lots of grass, predators in forests / jungles, and those who love fish fly in the clouds.

🍕 *Snacks*
🍯 A pot of honey, 🥞 Sweet pancakes - dinosaurs love snacks and will happily eat them regardless of their type!

Also, this food gives mood / health bonuses and more.

Full item information can be found in the inventory!
faq.accessories:
🏓 *Accessories*
Accessories unlock additional possibilities or speed up activities. 
Accessories can be equipped when your dinosaur is idle by using it in the inventory.
Accessories can be found in travels or dungeons.

🎲 *Here are some examples...*
 🧸 Bear - allows choosing a sleep mode.
 🛠 Tools - speeds up food collection.
faq.runes:
🔮 *Improvement Runes*

Runes are used in the workshop to influence the outcome of item upgrades:

1. *Confidence Rune (Type 1)*: Guarantees a 100% success rate for upgrades up to a specific level. For example, a level 3 rune guarantees success for upgrading to +1, +2, +3 levels.
2. *Luck Rune (Type 2)*: Adds a fixed percentage to the base upgrade success chance (e.g., +10% or +25%).

Use the /blacksmith command to access the workshop menu.

An ancient and mighty forest with giant trees, that's what they say about this forest...
I, Frederick Al Johnson, will check it myself!

book_lost-islands: It's me again, Aot. Today Propan told me about ancient ruins on the island and we are heading there.

When we reached the shore it got hot and we went for a swim.

After that, while walking along the shore, we noticed ruins of an old temple among the palms.

Going inside, we were struck by the grandeur of the ancient structure. Columns stood everywhere, and bas-reliefs were carved into the walls.

After exploring the temple, we found 300 coins!

Propan suddenly tripped over something and sprawled on the ground. I took a look. It turned out to be a book.

A little later, we explored a few more temples and found a cake and 3 mushrooms.

We fell asleep on the sand.

And in the morning, we returned home.
book_desert: Who doesn't know about mysterious pyramids, sandy dunes, and venomous snakes?

This brief story from my perspective on why you should, and sometimes shouldn't, venture into the desert where dinosaurs roam.

So let's begin.

After stuffing up on products, I set out to explore the desert.

The first day went perfectly... except for the scorching sun.

I found 50 square coins, where did they come from?

The next day I reached the pyramid. And by the way, I wasn't alone.

A giant dinosaur stood approximately 20 meters away from me. It pushed a wall and entered, and I waited for 5 minutes before entering too. The pyramid was massive, filled with labyrinths and passages.

I won't fully describe the pyramid as it would take too much time.

I'll just mention that I found a parchment with an image of a backpack and strange symbols.

I fell asleep directly in the pyramid.
The next morning I woke up with the feeling that someone was watching me. I opened my eyes and saw... A DINOSAUR! It stood directly in front of me and gazed at me, slightly tilting its head.
So I became friends with the dinosaur.
book_mountains: Hi, it's me again, Aot. Today Propan and I are going on a journey to the mountains.

Crystal mountains... How beautiful it is... And cold. Brrr.

Walking on the snow, Propane suddenly sank into a snowdrift. He crawled out. And again he sank. Then he counted his coins, took out a square one and flung it into the snow.

An hour later it started snowing and the dinosaur got upset.

When we were sitting by the fire, a white bear approached us. Propane hit it with his hind paw in the side. The bear flew a couple of meters, but still managed to catch the dinosaur.

The next day we found an egg. It was shimmering. Here it is white. Now it's green. In a moment it became blue. Now it's lilac. Orange. And white again.

 We continued our journey.

Propane bent down and picked up a sheet of parchment.

This recipe cake,-explained he -love cakes.

 And suddenly the blizzard started.

We found ourselves in a forest of strange trees, and between the trunks our house could be seen.

 We reached it and sat down to drink tea.

find_dwarf_ring.success: {dino} was digging through leaves and accidentally found the lost dwarf's ring!
